name: Lake Geneva
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Lake Geneva, WI 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Lake Geneva, Wisconsin for 2026: the Electric Christmas Parade, a trolley Tour of Lights, gingerbread and Santa breakfasts.
lede: Lake Geneva lights up with the Electric Christmas Parade downtown, then adds a Grand Geneva trolley Tour of Lights, a gingerbread walk, a Santa breakfast and parades in nearby Elkhorn and Delavan.
celebrates: Visit Lake Geneva presents the Electric Christmas Parade along Broad and Main Streets, which the tourism office describes as a colorful, light-filled parade followed by holiday shopping and dining specials in town. Grand Geneva Resort runs its annual Christmas in the Country celebration with more than two million lights and a trolley Tour of Lights, and Timber Ridge Lodge serves Breakfast with Santa in its ballroom. Elkhorn and Delavan add parades and tree lightings, so a family can spread the season across several lakeside towns.
lastyear: The 2025 holiday lights guide from At the Lake magazine listed the Electric Christmas Parade for Saturday, December 6, 2025, at 5 pm on Broad Street, and the Grand Geneva trolley Tour of Lights from November 24 through December 30. The resort says its Christmas in the Country celebration lasts about six weeks each year.
facts: Visit Lake Geneva calls the 2026 parade the 51st Annual Electric Christmas Parade, so the tradition dates to the 1970s. Grand Geneva Resort says its holiday display has more than two million lights, indoors and out, including a drive-through light show. The resort's Tinsel and Tonic pop-up bar is adults-only, so this page does not include it.
trains: Lake Geneva has no Christmas train of its own. The East Troy Railroad Museum, a short drive north, runs daytime and evening Christmas trains and the free Santa Parade Train, and our museum guide lists it. Lake Geneva families often combine a parade night with a train weekend in East Troy.

faq: How does Lake Geneva celebrate Christmas?

Lake Geneva celebrates with the Electric Christmas Parade in downtown, plus Grand Geneva Resort's Christmas in the Country with trolley light tours and a gingerbread walk. Timber Ridge Lodge serves Breakfast with Santa, and shops and restaurants offer holiday specials after the parade.
When is the Lake Geneva Electric Christmas Parade?
Visit Lake Geneva lists the parade at 5 pm on the first Saturday evening of December, moving down Broad and Main Streets. It is free to watch and followed by holiday shopping and dining.
How much is the Grand Geneva Tour of Lights?

Non-resort guests pay a set price per adult and a lower one for children 3 to 12, with young children free, according to the resort. Reservations are required, and there are no tours on Christmas Day.
Where can kids see Santa in Lake Geneva?
Timber Ridge Lodge holds Breakfast with Santa on several dates, with reservations through the lodge. Santa also appears at the Elkhorn Christmas Card Town Parade.
Are there parades near Lake Geneva?
Yes. Elkhorn holds its Christmas Card Town Parade on a Saturday afternoon and Delavan holds a tree lighting, Comet caroling and parade on the preceding Friday evening. Both are free.
